title: What are the odds two Pandemics could each fall on "19," as in, 1918-19 and 2019?
text:
What are the odds two Pandemics could each fall on "19," as in, 1918-19 and 2019?
well - lets fucking find out!
Statistically it is impossible:
It truly is. No probability ratio exists for that scenario to be true.
It can’t be true. And it isn’t. It just isn’t. Not a word you ever heard about either of those two “pandemics” was true. The fact that they shoved covid in our face like they did… and still held straight faced that it was true… even when it was obvious every single one of them was lying… is beyond me. I could understand if we were different species. That would at least make some of form of brutal genocidal sense. But this… no… none of it makes any sense. But regardless… they showed you their hand, dared you to call their bluff, and raised the stakes enough, so that you were too afraid to call them.
They always do that though.
Making you believe and fight for their lies. It’s part of this whole sick fucking ritual. Where you have to voluntarily accept their poisons. They can’t “force” you do things under the rules of the death cult they are running. That somehow breaks some of their internal protocols. It has to be about tricking you to suppress your own discernment. That is what they really get off on.
You have to willingly choose the form of death they offer you. Then - in their sick demented schema for all this - they are absolved from responsibility. They didn’t force you to do anything. You chose it of your own free will. That is their working guidelines for this madness. I don’t know how I know it… but I do.
People get offered horrible shit all the time, walking down the street, in back alleys, but they always refuse. Out of instinct and self-perseverance. Intuition and gut feeling.
But with whatever runs this insanity - as long as you make the choice yourself - to jab yourself, jab your kids, take their “medicines,” eat their food, drink their beverages… they believe they didn’t harm you. It was a choice. And you made it. They didn’t force you. You were given an option, and you chose wrongly. That’s as clearly as I explain their working guidelines along all this. Once you see inside their playbook, you see it everywhere.
(Two energy systems are out there: essentially just - 1 good and 1 bad. It’s essentially what Christianity speaks about, but that’s the religious side of things. And this ain’t got nothing to do with religion. These energy systems - they can influence, but can’t interfere. Can’t make you actually do it. You have to choose it willingly. More on that in future posts)
Now - “sickness” can’t transmit, and everyone knows that. “Sickness” is a personal corrective phase your body enters to right the ship (correct the balance), thus it is physically impossible to transfer internal dysregulation dynamics externally.
Example - go drink a big ass glass of Kool-Aid. Wait a little bit. Then go to the bathroom and take a whiz. Does Kool-Aid come out? Is what’s coming out, exactly what came in?
No - of course not. Why? Because your body has a detoxification process that breaks down substances into specific components. It uses what it can, what is supposed to be ingested, what the body can benefit from, and excretes in some manner, all the junk that is not supposed to be there.
And it is the exact same thing when your body deals with “sickness.” You feel bad of course. But you are not sick in your understanding of that word. Your internal registry was out of balance, out of alignment, producing the wrong ratios, stressed to the point where a corrective mechanism needed to step in and fix the internal dynamics, the internal chemistry, the internal balance. That is it.
When your cells are stressed… you feel fucking bad!
So to continue the Kool-Aid analogy - you body breaks down that junk, expels most of it, as none of it besides the water is needed, and you come back into balance (baseline). When the body is correcting itself - you are simply expelling what your cells have already run through an incredibly elegant detox protocol. Your regulatory cells activate, fight, invade, and kill the deregulating agents/processes.
The cells detox the improper ratios, and you, fucking you… expel what your body just detoxed for you. Think: runny nose, coughing, mucous, sneezing, vomiting, diarrhea, etc. All of that… fucking all of that… is expelling what your cells already detoxed.
Thus - even if you believed in the asinine germ theory bullshit, the germ that came in, ain’t what’s coming out! Feel me? Get it yet? What’s coming out is the detoxed breakdown from your cellular clean up crews hard work to get your internal processes back lined up again. Eat moldy food… yeah it’s fucking bacteria. Drink bad water… yeah its fucking microorganisms. Of fucking course.
But, the idiotic idea - that an invisible dangerous germ flew out of your friends mouth, hit your arm, absorbed through the skin, and created catastrophic systemic damage inside you - is beyond preposterous. How the exact same “germ” could come out after your body deconstructed it, defies every known law of biology on planet earth. So if you still believe that fairy-tale, please tell me why human fucking beings are the only animal in this world, that gets “sick” in that manner? Please explain that to me, I’m all ears. The Kool-Aid that comes out when you take a whiz, ain’t the same as you drank.
That’s as simple as I can make it for everyone.
I’m no superhuman. Nothing special. The last time I “had” a doctor was easily more than 3 decades ago. I don’t get sick much. Every now and again a runny nose. But that’s in winter, I’m low on natural vitamin D, and all the fruits and veggies I’m eating ain’t fresh no more. Been thawed after being stored for months on end, then placed back on the shelves pretending to be fresh. The last time I went to a doctor cause I was sick, I was still wearing feetie pajamas and using coloring books. Don’t believe me? What do I fucking care? I don’t know none of you, why they fuck would I try to impress avatars floating in cyberspace? Think it through.
I beg all of you (from the deepest part of my soul) to see with your eyes, and stop listening to idiots. I am right. I am right today. I will be right tomorrow. I will be right in 50 years. I will be right in a 100 fucking years. It doesn’t matter. It’s not about me. Not in the slightest.
It’s about humanity. And unless we all wake the fuck up… it’s gonna be too late.
Let’s have some fun with math… specifically, probability math
What are the chances the only two officially declared pandemics could each fall on the same year? Separated obviously, by 100 years exactly?
That is what I woke up thinking about
AI says: 1 in a billion or 1 in a trillion. Would you go to Vegas and bet on that?
So - like I always say - see with your own eyes - I fucking beg you!
(I just thought of something - but it’s too late to work it out. What if the pandemic of 1918 was version 1.0? Then, when they ran the same shit again, for covid, it was version 2.0? What would the fucking numbers be? Oh that’s right … 1918 and 2019!)

So to continue the Kool-Aid analogy - you body breaks down that junk, expels most of it, as none of it besides the water is needed, and you come back into balance (baseline). What’s coming out is the detoxed breakdown from your cellular clean up crews hard work to get your internal processes back lined up again.
